svg.title: Ag7Te4 particle morphology interpretation
svg.desc: Original MatterSyn schematic based on Li et al. 2001 Figure 2B TEM and XRD Figure 1. Approximately spherical particles of source-reported about 50 nm diameter appear in projected agglomerates. This is not an atomistic reconstruction or a measured image.

g.text: About 50 nm spherical particles; projected aggregates in TEM
Hexagonal Ag7Te4: a=13.51 Å, c=8.48 Å
Author-drawn particle interpretation from source Figure 2; particle count and aggregate geometry are not measured.
